---
name: Researcher workflow improvement
about: Suggest a concrete improvement to configuration, simulation, analysis, replay or documentation
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Which workflow needs improvement?
Describe the researcher task and the current friction. Include the CLI command,
GUI action or guide involved.

## Desired result
Give a concrete before/after example and the smallest useful change.

## Contracts and evidence
If the request changes scientific behavior, name the affected configuration,
algorithm or metric and cite its primary source. For interface or documentation
improvements, describe a practical acceptance check; a new algorithm is not required.

## Alternatives or examples
Link a relevant tool or add a small synthetic example when helpful.
